items.description: Managed point-in-time recovery — a cron-driven `snapshot` internalAction exports a configured set of tables to timestamped NDJSON in a dedicated R2 bucket, and a cron-driven `prune` internalAction ages snapshots out by retention window. Pairs with `cirrus backup restore` (nearest snapshot + `--to` CDC replay).

items.title: Backup

items.title: Crons
